findings.fix: Removed the module-level `isDataSourcesSurfaceEnabled` const in src/router.tsx (was evaluated at import time via isFeatureEnabled(), before appInfoStore.fetchCustomerConfig() resolves, so it was always false in the real app). dataSourceRoutes is now spread unconditionally into the route table (src/router.tsx:710), matching the existing precedent used for cost-centers-management/analytics routes. Each of the 4 dataSourceRoutes route elements is now wrapped in `<FeatureGuard featureFlag={dataSourcesSurfaceFlags}>` (src/router.tsx:279-317), which re-evaluates reactively against live config on every render via useSnapshot(appInfoStore) instead of freezing a decision at import time.

Navigation.tsx itself required no change — its reactive isDataSourcesSurfaceEnabled gate (useFeatureFlag-based, lines 71-75) was already correct per the review; only the router-side route existence was broken.
